relations.subject: Hsuan Hua
relations.evidence: In 1959, Hsuan Hua sought to bring Chinese Buddhism to the West. He instructed his disciples in America to establish a Buddhist association which came to be the Dharma Realm Buddhist Association

relations.subject: Hsuan Hua
relations.evidence: Hsuan Hua founded Dharma Realm Buddhist University at CTTB.

relations.subject: Hsuan Hua
relations.evidence: He also founded the Buddhist Text Translation Society in 1970.
